title: Personal agent flow
lede: Sam asks Muse for something. Protect works out who is calling. An agent call waits for Sam's consent; a person's call goes straight on. Privilege then checks the tool and the call. Everything here is simulated.

nodes.label: Coarse check
sub: Which personas may call the tool

steps.title: Sam asks Muse
steps.what: Muse takes the request from Sam's signed-in session.

steps.title: Protect
steps.what: Protect works out who is calling: Muse, an agent, or a person in the browser. Muse-detect also checks for bursts and hidden instructions. A block stops the call here.

steps.title: Consent (agent only)
steps.what: An agent call waits for Sam to consent. A person's call skips this step.

steps.title: Coarse check
steps.what: Privilege asks whether this persona may call the tool at all. A deny stops the call here.

steps.title: Fine check
steps.what: Privilege applies the business rule to this call. Over the limit, the call is held until a person approves it.

steps.title: Resource
steps.what: The call is allowed, so the tool runs.
